description:
Say what is wrong with what a request produced, and have it reworked.

    Status must be "done". `feedback_md` is 1..1979 chars. Moves the thread to
    refine_pending; get_request_status reports the revised items. Refinement
    re-plans the thread's roadmap items and can EDIT OR HARD-DELETE the task rows
    it generated earlier (the machine patch-tasks endpoint deletes them
    outright), so it is destructive: up to five refinements per thread each
    carry that power.
name: refine_request
title: Refine Request
